reviews.author: Anthony G.
reviews.text: Elier is hands down one of the best barbers in Vegas. The skin fade is super sharp and the straight razor shave was incredible. Clean shop, great music, and friendly atmosphere.

reviews.author: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Bryan gave me the best beard trim and low taper Ive had in years. Attention to detail is top notch. The vibe at Boulevard Barber Shop on 6th Street is authentic old school.

reviews.author: Carlos M.
reviews.text: Lay hooked me up with a flawless drop fade and razor edge. Always prompt, professional, and consistent. Highly recommended if you want a clean cut in downtown!

reviews.author: Derek S.
reviews.text: Booked the VIP hotel service on the Strip and was blown away. Arrived right on time, fully equipped, and gave me a fresh cut before my conference. 5 stars all the way.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins or are appointments required?
faqs.answer: Walk-ins are always welcome during all regular business hours! However, to guarantee your chair and master barber without waiting, we recommend booking online in advance via Booksy.

faqs.question: Where are you located and is there parking?
faqs.answer: We are located at 906 S 6th St #105, Las Vegas, NV 89101 near S 6th St & E Charleston Blvd in Downtown Las Vegas. Free customer parking is available on-site.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, major credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Booksy contactless direct pay.

faqs.question: Do you offer mobile or on-location hotel haircut services?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer VIP on-location haircut services for homes, offices, and Las Vegas Strip resort hotel suites. You can book our VIP mobile service directly.
